statement: Memory stockpiles at Samsung Electronics and SK hynix have fallen below 10 days of supply as of Q3 2026.
why: Sub-10-day memory inventory removes the buffer that has absorbed AI-server demand spikes, so any incremental HBM or server-DRAM order now bids directly against tight capacity.

impact.mechanism: With no chain inventory left to draw down, memory becomes the gating input for AI accelerator modules, raising bill-of-materials cost and lengthening GPU-server build timing.

evidence.excerpt: Memory chip stockpiles at Samsung Electronics and SK hynix have fallen to less than 10 days of supply as of Q3.

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet relaying a single sell-side source (KB Securities); no producer filing or disclosure confirms the inventory figure.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: Seoul Economic Daily (en.sedaily.com), TrendForce
